## Type of Change

Please delete options that are not relevant:

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update (changes to README, docs, or inline docstrings)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance optimization / code refactoring

## Checklist

Before submitting this PR, please check off all boxes that apply:

- [ ] My code follows the repository's style guidelines (PEP 8, ESLint/React formatting).
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation (e.g. `docs/`, `README.md`).
- [ ] My changes generate no new compiler or runtime warnings.
- [ ] I have added unit tests that cover my changes.
- [ ] All new and existing tests pass locally (`pytest backend/tests/test_api.py`).
- [ ] I have verified the docker-compose setup builds and runs cleanly (`docker-compose build`).
